integrity: All theorem hypotheses and finite witness matrices supplied; original contributions are the unified formula, low-degree constructions and all two-colouring counts.
scientific_limitations: Complete bipartite simple graphs with both parts at least two; prior work covers two four-colour obstructions and min-degree-five sufficient threshold; no optimal three-/four-colouring enumerator; independent audit not performed.
title: Complete strong-majority edge-colouring classification of \(K_{m,n}\)
